_comment: Copy this whole `clients/_template` folder to `clients/<new-client-id>` and fill in every field below. Folder name = the value you'll export as CLIENT_ID when building (e.g. clients/king-faisal -> CLIENT_ID=king-faisal).
_loanInterestMethod_options: defaults.loanInterestMethod is 'flat' or 'reducing_balance' — flat is simple interest (SACCO-style), reducing_balance is amortized (bank-style). This is just the day-one default for new groups; each group can change it later in group settings.
